name: IndianBailJudgments-1200
description: IndianBailJudgments-1200 is a high-quality, structured dataset comprising 1,200 annotated Indian bail-related court orders spanning five decades (1975–2025). It captures granular legal information across 78 courts and 28 regions, including crime types, IPC sections invoked, judge names, legal issues, bail outcomes, and bias indicators.
